installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# GitHub Sync and Build Script

apt update
apt install -y git curl jq file unzip make gcc g++ python3

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

if [ -z "${GIT_REPO}" ]; then
  echo -e "\n\nError: GIT_REPO variable is not set.\n"
  exit 1
fi

if [ -d ".git" ]; then
  echo -e "\n\nUpdating existing repository...\n"
  git fetch origin
  git reset --hard origin/${GIT_BRANCH}
else
  echo -e "\n\nCloning repository...\n"
  git clone --branch ${GIT_BRANCH} ${GIT_REPO} .
fi

echo -e "\n\nInstalling dependencies...\n"
npm install

echo -e "\n\nBuilding application...\n"
npm run build

echo -e "\n\nInstallation complete.\n"
